description: Get a single feedback item with its full reply thread. element_id is the item's id, as feedback_list, recent_activity, search or wait_for_feedback return it. Use it when an item has replies (feedback_list gives reply_count, not the replies) or to read one item again; to list an asset's feedback use feedback_list. Returns the item's text body (for recordings: the AI-organized feedback), tags (by name), author, posted_by_agent, video timestamp, the recording (recording_type voice, camera or screen; its full verbatim transcript; pipeline_status - the transcript is final once it is complete), visual_references (the pointing phrases - "this", "over here" - with the recording time each was spoken), visuals (the drawings and images), and all replies (each with reply_to = this item's id). content is Markdown: [0:26](#t=26) links a moment of the video (S in #t=S is video seconds, a range is #t=S,E), and [this](#rt=15.7) marks a phrase spoken at recording time 15.7s (the same values as recording.visual_references). An item with a visuals field: call get_annotated_frames(id) once - it shows what every #rt link points at.

element_id.description: Feedback item ID to retrieve: the id field of an item from feedback_list, recent_activity, search or wait_for_feedback

name: feedback_get
title: Get feedback
